# Scott Labz

> Scott Labz, LLC is an independent analytics and digital practice based in Bloomington-Normal, Illinois. It builds the tracking, platforms, and reporting that turn messy business data into decisions organizations can trust, with work across professional sports, collegiate athletics, motorsports, healthcare, higher education, nonprofits, and consumer brands.

Scott Labz is led by founder and principal analytics consultant Scott Taylor. Work covers four areas: analytics and data (measurement, tag management, dashboards, data quality), web and digital development (custom sites, ecommerce, infrastructure), conversion optimization (testing and funnel analysis), and advertising and media buying. Engagements are built on direct accountability and no unnecessary dependencies.

Contact: info@scottlabz.com, +1-309-340-4306, or https://scottlabz.com/contact

Published writing is Field Notes (incident write-ups) and Insights (principles), both listed on the Field Notes page, and case studies have their own index. Each one has a JSON manifest listing every entry with its title, summary, categories, publish date, and URL, so agents can read the full index without scraping HTML:

- Field Notes manifest: https://scottlabz.com/field-notes/field-notes.json
- Insights manifest: https://scottlabz.com/insights/insights.json
- Case Studies manifest: https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/case-studies.json (client case studies and the workstream deep dives, with title, summary, categories, and URL)

- [Conversion Optimization & Testing](https://scottlabz.com/conversion-optimization): Structured testing, funnel analysis, and evidence-based site changes
- [Advertising & Media Buying](https://scottlabz.com/advertising-media-buying): Campaign planning, media buying, and conversion tracking built on the same measurement discipline

## Case Studies

- [Case studies overview](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies): All client case studies
- [Hawkeye Fan Shop](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/hawkeye-fan-shop): Measurement, product-page tracking, and site reliability through a decade of gameday traffic
- [The Black & Gold Shop](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/the-black-and-gold-shop): Measurement, development, and infrastructure for a scalable storefront
- [Kitchens](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/kitchens): A one-page website for a family-owned cookware store with two locations, with store details, coffee lists, recipes, sign-ups and the old site's links redirected
- [Couchletics](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/couchletics): Brand identity and a custom online store for a sleepwear and lounge brand
- [Snoring Beagle](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/snoring-beagle): A custom online store for a dog bed brand, with a bed finder, gift cards and shipping priced from carrier rates
- [The Lottery Matrix](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/the-lottery-matrix): A live Powerball and Mega Millions statistics site, updated after every drawing from official results and measured against the real odds
- [Measurement Strategy & Implementation](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/hawkeye-fan-shop/digital-analytics-implementation): A ground-up measurement strategy and analytics build for reliable, validated tracking
- [Connected Reporting](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/hawkeye-fan-shop/analytics-dashboard-reporting): Store, gameday, and online systems connected into one reporting platform with stakeholder dashboards
- [Custom Storefront & Infrastructure](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/hawkeye-fan-shop/custom-web-application-development): A full ecommerce platform built from domain to storefront, with inventory in sync across every store
- [Data Quality & Governance](https://scottlabz.com/case-studies/hawkeye-fan-shop/data-quality-governance): Ongoing validation and governance standards for analytics data
